en.title: Stack vs Heap
en.note:
## What it is

A variable of a value type contains its data; a variable of a reference type contains a pointer to an object on the managed heap. The accurate rule: a value lives wherever its containing variable lives, so a struct field of a class sits inline in the heap object.

en.prompt: Where is a struct stored when it is a field of a class instance?

options.text: Inline inside the class object on the heap

en.explanation: A struct field is laid out inline in its parent object, so it lives on the heap.
